name: ChatGPT
description: Conversational AI assistant for any task.
longDescription: ChatGPT is a general-purpose conversational assistant built on OpenAI's GPT models. It can write, reason, code, summarize, and hold multi-turn conversations across nearly any domain, with plugins and custom GPTs extending it further.
cons: Paid tier needed for best models

name: Claude
description: Helpful, honest AI assistant with long context.
longDescription: Claude is Anthropic's family of AI models, known for careful reasoning, long context windows, strong coding ability, and a safety-first design philosophy. Available via chat, API, and IDE integrations.
cons: Slower than some competitors on simple tasks

name: Gemini
longDescription: Gemini is Google's multimodal AI model family integrated across Search, Workspace, and Android, capable of understanding text, images, audio, and video in a single conversation.

name: Perplexity
longDescription: Perplexity combines large language models with real-time web search to deliver cited, up-to-date answers, making it a favorite research and fact-checking tool.
cons: Can miss nuance in complex topics

name: GitHub Copilot
description: AI pair programmer inside your editor.
longDescription: GitHub Copilot suggests whole lines or functions of code in real time inside popular editors, trained on billions of lines of public code and tuned for developer workflows.

name: Cursor
description: AI-first code editor built on VS Code.
longDescription: Cursor is a code editor forked from VS Code with AI deeply woven into the editing experience, letting developers chat with, edit, and generate code across an entire codebase.
cons: Paid plan needed for heavy use

name: Windsurf
longDescription: Windsurf is an agentic IDE that can autonomously plan and execute multi-step coding tasks across a project, going beyond simple autocomplete into full task execution.

name: Midjourney
description: AI image generator known for artistic quality.
longDescription: Midjourney generates highly stylized, artistic images from text prompts, run primarily through Discord, and is favored by artists and designers for its distinctive aesthetic.

name: Leonardo AI
description: AI platform for game and creative assets.
longDescription: Leonardo AI provides fine-tuned models for generating game assets, concept art, and marketing images, with tools for training custom models on your own style.

name: Runway
description: AI video generation and editing suite.
longDescription: Runway offers a suite of AI tools for generating and editing video, including text-to-video, video-to-video, and green-screen removal, aimed at filmmakers and creators.

name: ElevenLabs
description: Realistic AI voice generation and cloning.
longDescription: ElevenLabs produces highly realistic text-to-speech and voice cloning, used for audiobooks, dubbing, and voiceovers across dozens of languages.

name: Canva AI
description: AI design tools built into Canva.
longDescription: Canva AI (Magic Studio) adds AI-powered design generation, background removal, and text-to-image directly into Canva's drag-and-drop design platform.
cons: Less control than pure design tools

name: Notion AI
description: AI writing and knowledge assistant inside Notion.
longDescription: Notion AI is built into the Notion workspace app, helping users draft, summarize, translate, and organize notes and documents without leaving their existing workflow.
cons: Only useful if already using Notion

name: Grammarly
description: AI writing assistant for grammar and style.
longDescription: Grammarly checks grammar, tone, and clarity across browsers, desktop apps, and Office, and now includes generative AI features for rewriting and drafting text.

name: DeepL
longDescription: DeepL uses neural networks to deliver translations widely regarded as more natural and accurate than typical machine translation, across 30+ languages.

name: Suno
description: AI music generation from text prompts.
longDescription: Suno generates full songs, including vocals and instrumentation, from simple text prompts, letting anyone create original music without instruments or production skills.

name: HeyGen
longDescription: HeyGen creates talking avatar videos from text scripts, supporting custom avatars and voice cloning, popular for marketing and training videos.

name: Synthesia
description: AI video creation with digital presenters.
longDescription: Synthesia turns text scripts into professional videos featuring AI presenters, widely used for corporate training and explainer videos in 120+ languages.

name: Adobe Firefly
longDescription: Adobe Firefly is a family of generative AI models integrated into Photoshop, Illustrator, and Express, trained on licensed content for commercially safe creative generation.
cons: Needs Creative Cloud for full power

name: Stable Diffusion
longDescription: Stable Diffusion is an open-source text-to-image model that can be run locally or via cloud services, offering full customization, fine-tuning, and no vendor lock-in.
cons: Requires technical setup for local use

name: Jasper
description: AI content platform for marketing teams.
longDescription: Jasper is built for marketing teams to generate on-brand blog posts, ads, and social copy at scale, with brand voice and campaign workflow tools.

name: Copy.ai
longDescription: Copy.ai generates marketing copy and automates go-to-market workflows, combining generative writing with light automation for sales and marketing teams.

name: Otter.ai
longDescription: Otter.ai records and transcribes meetings in real time, generating summaries, action items, and searchable notes synced with calendar apps.

name: Gamma
longDescription: Gamma generates polished presentations, documents, and webpages from a text prompt or outline, removing manual slide design work.

name: Descript
description: Edit audio and video by editing text.
longDescription: Descript lets creators edit podcasts and videos by editing a text transcript, plus AI tools for filler-word removal, voice cloning, and studio sound.
cons: Steeper learning curve for pro features

name: Replit AI
longDescription: Replit AI, including its Agent, helps build and deploy full applications directly in the browser, from code generation to hosting.

name: Tabnine
longDescription: Tabnine offers AI code completion with an emphasis on privacy, offering on-premises and local model options for enterprises with strict data policies.
cons: Less capable than top competitors on complex tasks

name: Character.AI
longDescription: Character.AI lets users create and converse with custom AI personas and characters, popular for roleplay, entertainment, and companionship-style chat.

name: You.com
description: AI search engine with app integrations.
longDescription: You.com is an AI-powered search engine that blends chat, web results, and app-like modes for coding, writing, and research into a single interface.

name: Hugging Face
description: Open-source AI model and dataset hub.
longDescription: Hugging Face hosts thousands of open-source models, datasets, and Spaces, and provides libraries like Transformers used widely across the AI research community.

name: Dataiku
description: Enterprise AI and data science platform.
longDescription: Dataiku provides a visual, collaborative platform for building, deploying, and monitoring machine learning and AI models at enterprise scale.

name: Zapier AI
longDescription: Zapier AI adds natural-language automation building to its workflow platform, connecting thousands of apps with AI-generated logic and actions.

name: Salesforce Einstein
longDescription: Einstein embeds predictive and generative AI directly into Salesforce, powering lead scoring, email drafting, and forecasting within existing CRM workflows.

name: Intercom Fin
longDescription: Fin is Intercom's AI agent that resolves customer support tickets automatically using a company's help center content, escalating to humans when needed.
cons: Needs good help docs to work well

name: Wealthfront Autopilot
longDescription: Wealthfront uses algorithmic and AI-driven strategies to automatically manage diversified investment portfolios and optimize for tax efficiency.

name: Cleo
longDescription: Cleo is a chat-based budgeting app that uses AI with a playful tone to track spending, build savings, and nudge better financial habits.

name: Duolingo Max
longDescription: Duolingo Max adds generative AI features like Explain My Answer and Roleplay conversations on top of Duolingo's gamified language courses.
cons: AI features limited to certain languages

name: Khanmigo
description: AI tutor for students and teachers.
longDescription: Khanmigo is an AI tutor integrated with Khan Academy's curriculum, guiding students through problems with Socratic questioning instead of giving direct answers.
cons: Can feel slow vs direct answers

name: QuillBot
longDescription: QuillBot helps rewrite, summarize, and check grammar in text, popular among students and writers for quickly rephrasing content while preserving meaning.

name: Murf AI
longDescription: Murf generates studio-quality voiceovers from text in a wide range of voices and languages, aimed at video creators, e-learning, and marketing.

name: Krisp
longDescription: Krisp uses on-device AI to remove background noise and echo from calls in real time, working across any conferencing app.

name: Figma AI
longDescription: Figma AI adds generative features like image generation, auto-layout suggestions, and content-aware renaming directly into the Figma design workflow.

name: Framer AI
description: AI website builder and design tool.
longDescription: Framer AI generates full responsive websites from a text prompt, combining a no-code visual editor with production-ready hosting.

name: Adept
description: AI agent that operates software for you.
longDescription: Adept builds AI agents designed to take actions inside real software interfaces, automating multi-step tasks across web apps on a user's behalf.

name: Ideogram
description: AI image generator with accurate text rendering.
longDescription: Ideogram specializes in generating images with legible, accurate text, useful for logos, posters, and designs where readable typography matters.

name: Pika
description: AI video generation from text and images.
longDescription: Pika generates short AI videos from text prompts or existing images, with tools for camera control, lip sync, and stylistic effects.

name: Clay
longDescription: Clay combines dozens of data providers with AI to research leads, enrich contact records, and personalize outbound sales messaging at scale.

name: ChatPDF
description: Chat with the contents of any PDF.
longDescription: ChatPDF lets users upload a PDF and ask questions about its content, returning answers grounded in the document with page references.
cons: Free tier has file size limits

name: Consensus
description: AI search engine for scientific papers.
longDescription: Consensus searches peer-reviewed research papers and extracts key findings, helping users get evidence-based answers instead of general web results.

name: Beautiful.ai
longDescription: Beautiful.ai automatically adjusts slide layouts as you add content, using design rules to keep presentations visually consistent without manual formatting.
cons: Less flexible than manual design tools

name: D-ID
longDescription: D-ID animates photos into talking-head videos synced to text or audio, used for presenters, customer service avatars, and personalized video messaging.

name: Writesonic
description: AI content and SEO writing platform.
longDescription: Writesonic generates SEO-optimized articles, ad copy, and product descriptions, with built-in tools for keyword research and content scoring.

name: Synthflow
longDescription: Synthflow lets businesses build AI voice agents for phone calls, handling scheduling and customer inquiries without writing code.
cons: Setup takes tuning to sound natural

name: Galileo AI
longDescription: Galileo AI generates editable user-interface designs from text descriptions, giving designers a fast starting point for app and web screens.
